remarks: Set on nearly two acres of beautifully landscaped, park-like grounds, this enchanting 1930s Colonial is tucked away on a private lane just moments from the village and train. Classic architectural details grace the formal living room with fireplace and the elegant dining room, accented by custom built-ins. A richly paneled library with window seat offers an inviting retreat - equally suited as a sophisticated home office. The country kitchen flows effortlessly into a warm and welcoming family room centered around its own fireplace, perfect for both everyday living and effortless entertaining. A generous stone terrace extends the living space outdoors, framing sweeping eastern views across the expansive lawn, flowering trees, and mature plantings. Upstairs, a spacious primary suite is complemented by three additional bedrooms - completing a home that is as timeless in its charm as it is serene in its privacy.
